name: Slideshow Flash Zoom
description: Full-screen image slideshow where each new slide slides in from below while scaling up, with an inner image zoom and a bright flash that settles to normal. Driven by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint label with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer gestures move to the previous or next slide through GSAP Observer
New slide scales in and slides vertically while the inner image zooms out from a brightness flash
Previous slide fades out, slides loop endlessly
Gestures are ignored while a transition runs
Images are preloaded before the slideshow becomes visible
editableByProps: Background, hint text and nav button colors and size
Transition duration, easing, start scales and flash brightness
Wheel sensitivity and nav button visibility, hint text

needsCodeEdit.where: yPercent in the fromTo call on upcomingSlide

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow glyphs on the buttons
needsCodeEdit.where: ← and → inside the two nav buttons

fixed: Fills the viewport height and the container is hidden until images finish loading
Wheel and touch gestures on the slideshow area trigger slide changes
